samples.question: Every grid in this image is a 5 by 5 grid of square cells, and cell positions are read the same way in each grid (row 1 is the top row, column 1 is the left column). The upper-left grid, labeled PLATE, shows dark gray filled cells. The upper-right grid, labeled RESULT, was made by keeping every filled cell of PLATE and filling some further cells; RESULT is drawn in one single dark gray ink, so it does not show which of its filled cells were added. The bottom row shows four stencils, one red, one blue, one green and one orange. Exactly one stencil has colored cells at exactly the cells that are filled in RESULT but not filled in PLATE, with no missing cell and no extra cell. Which color is that stencil? Answer with one of: red, blue, green, orange.
